beats.line: you will have to rappel all through freezing waterfalls
squeeze through multiple narrow twisty tunnels
that are barely the size of a human body
and walk through steep freezing waters
and after four long days of descending into pure agony
you finally make it to the bottom of the cave where your guide will take a small sample of dirt
pat you on the back and instruct you to turn back around since they got what they came for
Talk about a complete waste of time. Number two:
the Rat Dungeon. What could possibly be worse
than being stuck in a cold dark claustrophobic space
